root_idea.summary: The root centers on elevation: sitting up involves moving from a lower posture or place to a higher one, and related terms extend to elevated, hard terrain.
root_idea.development: The primary notion of rugged or elevated ground develops into the act of sitting up or sitting, then into terms for a sitting-place and the people or activities associated with it.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular dictionary citation مَجْلِسٌ; the supplied Quran occurrence is its plural form مَجَالِس.

senses.definition: A sitting-place: a place or setting where people sit.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic plural مَجَالِس, the term can refer to the places in which people sit or gather.

senses.definition: An assembly or company of people sitting together.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural مَجَالِس is contextually used for assemblies or gatherings in which people sit; the surrounding instruction concerns making room in them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sit; to sit up after sleeping, lying down, or prostration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may describe sitting up or becoming seated, and in جَلَسَ مَعَهُ or جَلَسَ إِلَيْهِ it means to sit with or by someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an aquiline vulture, to lie or crouch on its breast upon the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized use, synonymous with جَثَمَ in the cited description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain or continue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An assumed figurative extension, also said of a thing such as a plant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come to al-Jals, the elevated country of Najd.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same usage can be said of a cloud coming to Najd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sit with someone; to keep someone’s company in sitting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or associational construction, as in sitting with someone with whom one is congenial.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seat someone; to make someone sit or sit up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can also mean to give someone a place or settle someone in a sitting position.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sit together, one with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited construction places the participants together in sitting-places or assemblies.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask or desire someone to sit or sit up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form expresses requesting or wanting another person to take a seated position.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rugged, hard, or elevated ground; especially the high country of Najd.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote a widely extending elevated tract and is contrasted with low country.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Persons sitting or sitting up; a company of people seated together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can function as a quasi-plural or as a designation for the people of a sitting-place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who remains seated in the courtyard; according to another usage, a woman of noble rank among her people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are specialized lexical usages reported for the feminine referent of the term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single sitting or act of sitting up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes one occurrence of the action rather than its manner or state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The mode, manner, kind, or state of sitting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It describes how someone sits, as in having a good or commendable sitting posture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who sits much; a sedentary person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is an epithet for habitual or excessive sitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A companion with whom one sits.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word denotes a sitting companion or associate and has established plural forms in Classical Arabic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man or cloud coming to the high country of Najd.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized use is distinct from the ordinary active-participial sense of being seated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seat or other thing upon which one sits.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is distinct from مَجْلِسٌ as the place or gathering in which people sit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An oration, discourse, or exhortation delivered in a sitting or assembly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized figurative use referring to speech associated with a مَجْلِس.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who is an object of resort, with whom others sit and converse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This usage occurs in the construction مَجْلِسُ فُلَانٍ, by extension from the place where people gather with him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In medical usage, a stool or evacuation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical usage recorded for medical books.
